## 150b. Router design v3 + preregistration §C lock + archive diagnostic verdicts (2026-05-16) [design][finding][infra] #design #finding #infra

**Trigger**: §149 router v1→v2 (3-AI cross-stress) 完成后 user 在 conversation 内追加 3 个 OOB catches (P0-8 / P0-9 / P0-10), 全部 Claude+codex+gemini 3 AI 都漏。User instruction: "直接改 preregistration"。这次 session 把 v2 → v3 设计 + preregistration §C 三 patch 落 + archive diagnostic 跑通, 验证 H10 DEFER pre-data triggered。

### 150b.1 User-caught 3 OOB findings (v2 → v3)

- **P0-8 (`task.category` provenance)**: v2 P2 Stage 1 候选 pool 列 "manual task category one-hot (4, runtime-known from VWA `task.category`)" — Claude + codex + gemini 都把它当 VWA-native 信任了，但 P79 Cat A/B/C/D 实际是 codex audit derived (`docs/analysis/cross_sites/codex_audit_classifieds.json` + `codex_audit_reddit.json`)。VWA-native 任务对象有 `task_id` / `intent` / `image_url` / `start_url`, **没有**语义 category 字段。Same-class P0 leak as v1 `has_reference_image`。
- **P0-9 OOB (visual hijack 三轴)**: v2 P1+P2 决策没用 §100/§101/§M1 probe data。Probe 显示 hijack trigger = capability (B0 immune / B1 susceptible) × mark density (33→128 marks 时 B1 num_ids 0→446) × site (reddit 74 / cls 111 marks)。`[SOM_MARKS]` text fallback 让 attention bypass screenshot (num_ids 归 0) → Phantom-SoM 4-fold drop-in 的直接 mechanism 解释。
- **P0-10 OOB (`has_ref_image` task-attached)**: v2 P1 L1 rule `if has_ref_image → SoM` 写错了 reason — reference image 是 task-attached, **所有 mode 都看得到** (`docs/analysis/phantom_paper/B0_dom_shopping_diagnostic.md:87`)。正确 reasoning = "task 图需要跟 page 图对比, page 图只在 SoM/Vision screenshot 里", 但 (has_ref_image × model × density) 三轴交互让 hard-rule 不安全 — 笔记 line 2305 实测 B1 reddit Cat B (ref-image) 反转 -3.6pp。

### 150b.2 v3 关键变化 (`router_proposals_v3.md`)

- **P1 v3** 真正 capability-blind: 删除 `has_ref_image` L1 rule + 不加 capability-aware hijack guard, 留 single-axis intent regex (`is_search → DOM`) + first-step browser-state escalation + L3 stateful escalation。Effort 1.5 days (-0.5 day vs v2)
- **P2 v3** 删 audit Cat 4-way categorical, 改 5 runtime intent regex binaries (`has_filter/sort/compare/aggregate/account_action`)。Stage 1 候选 pool 53 features (was 50), 含新加 `model` one-hot (P0-9 fix capability axis) + `axtree_element_count_step1` (P0-9 fix density axis); Stage 2 mutual info top-18 selection 让 LR 自动 surface (model × density × has_ref_image) 三轴交互。Effort 6-8 days
- **P1 vs P2 真正 scientific distinction**: P1 = capability-blind handcrafted single-axis baseline; P2 = learned capability-aware multi-axis classifier。Defuses 之前 gemini C1 "phantom renaming" attack (paper-1 P2 vs paper-2 H7 oracle 区分)

### 150b.4 Archive diagnostic 跑通 — paper-grade verdict 3 项 land

`scripts/analysis/router_archive_diagnostic.py` 在 B0 cls + reddit × 6 modes 现有 archive 上跑 G-1/G-2/G-4 (G-3/G-5/G-6 标 second pass)。Verdict 落 `docs/checkpoints/router/archive_diagnostic_2026-05-16.{md,json}`:

| Cell | G-1 entropy | P2 viable? | G-2 Kendall τ | Anchor stable? | G-4 SD (pp) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| B0 cls (5-mode partial, phantom_prompt 4ep aborted) | 0.734 | YES (barely) | 0.696 | NO (临界) | 2.23 |
| B0 reddit (6-mode full) | **0.606** | **NO** | 0.841 | YES | 2.17 |

**关键发现**:
1. **H10 DEFER 被 pre-data triggered (reddit cell)**: reddit entropy 0.606 < log(2)=0.693 → per preregistration C1 pre-registered defer condition, **H10 整 family 塌缩为 paper-2 deferred, paper §6 router 只剩 H9 (rule-based)**。Reddit 上 86% tasks (181/210) argmax 在 DOM, learned classifier 退化为 "predict cheap default"。这是 OSF audit-trail-clean 的 pre-data decision, reviewer 不能 accuse HARKing。
2. **Anchor 实际锁定**: cls = `som` (full-cell best + majority winner 100% 一致); reddit = `phantom_som` (full-cell best + majority winner 58.4% — phantom_text 38.0% 第二)
3. **δ calibration rule 需 advisor 决断**: C1 patch 写 "SD > 0.5pp → δ → max(1.0, 2×SD)" but observed SD=2.2pp → would 提到 4.4pp。但 SD 是 sampling SE of lift estimator, 不是 null-distribution noise floor; δ 应该是 minimum-meaningful-effect floor (mirror H1 δ=1.0pp logic)。建议 **保留 δ=1.0pp + 显式 disclose 低 power (~12% at observed effects)**, 不 raise δ。这条 rule wording 需 advisor sync 修。

## 151. Router design v4 — Option C methodology fix (archive demoted from preregistration lock substrate to sanity check) (2026-05-16 evening) [design][bug][infra] #design #bug #infra

**Trigger**: §150b 落地后 user 一句 "用 archive 测的 router 是不是有问题" — paper-grade reviewer-level OOB attack, **Claude + codex + gemini + Mode A 4 个 AI 整个 v1→v2→v3 stress cycle 都 miss**。User catch 是 P0-11 OOB-after-3-AI-stress。

### 151.1 User catch 本质

`router_archive_diagnostic.py` 跑在 B0 paper-grade-pre-bug archive 上 (cls 0-233 / red 0-209 task IDs)。但:
- Phase 1a 用**完全相同**的 task IDs
- Archive 是 pre-§107/§139.8 fix 数据, `success` 值漂移
- 用 archive 锁 H10 DEFER / anchor fallback / δ rule **等价于 peeking at test set**

3 个 AI 都把 archive 当 black-box pre-data substrate 信任了, 没人质疑 task-ID overlap。这是 OOB attack 只有完整 project context (知道 task ID 跨 run 复用) 的 reviewer 才能 surface。

### 151.2 6 specific methodology issues

1. Archive pre-bug 数据 → `success` 漂移
2. 同 task ID population → pattern leak
3. B0-only → 不能验证 B1/B2 cells
4. Hijack mechanism 在 B0 invisible → P2 设计中心理论 untestable
5. Pre-locked thresholds 用 Brownlee/Hastie defense 在 task-ID overlap 下 fails
6. "Raise δ to 2×SD" rule 统计层就错 (SD 是 estimator SE, δ 是 effect-size floor — 两层不同 quantity 不能 conflate)

### 151.3 Option C fix — archive 改 sanity check, locks 全移 Phase 1a fresh data

3 candidates 用户批 Option C:
- Option A: 完全 nested CV on Phase 1a (~5× compute, 超参不稳)
- Option B: literature-default 锁完全 ungrounded (~不行)
- **Option C ⭐**: archive 改 "correlated-population sanity check" + Phase 1a fresh data 作 primary trigger substrate (中间地带, honest)

### 151.4 5 retract/reframe edits 直接落

1. **preregistration §C1 H10 DEFER trigger 改源**: `archive G-1 entropy` → `Phase 1a fresh-data train-fold entropy` (rule pre-data-locked, trigger evaluated post-launch)
2. **preregistration §C2 anchor-flicker trigger 改源**: `archive G-2 Kendall τ` → `Phase 1a fresh-data train-fold Kendall τ`
3. **preregistration §C1 "raise δ to 2×SD" rule retracted entirely**: 统计错 + archive-dependent 双重错; δ=1.0pp 锁定 effect-size floor, paper §6 显式 disclose ~12-20% per-cell power
4. **v3 P1 threshold framing v4 改**: "pre-locked on archive" → "literature/typical default (VWA WebArena 文献 8-15K range 选 12K; SeeAct/BrowserGym 400-600 range 选 500); archive sanity-check 确认 direction"
5. **`docs/checkpoints/router/archive_diagnostic_2026-05-16.md` 顶部加 SANITY-CHECK ONLY 警告 + verdict 段改 "directional confidence" 不是 "DEFER triggered"

加 Appendix A 2026-05-16 evening entry 记录 chronicle。

### 151.5 v3 H10 DEFER "pre-data triggered" 在 v4 中变成什么?

§150b chronicle 声称 "H10 pre-data DEFER triggered on reddit (archive entropy 0.606)" — **v4 retract 这个声称**。H10 DEFER 是 conditional **rule**, trigger 评估在 Phase 1a fresh data 上, 不在 archive。

Archive verdict (reddit entropy 0.606) 现在是 "directional confidence: 可能 Phase 1a B0 reddit train-fold entropy 也会触发 DEFER, 但不锁定". Phase 1a fresh-data 上 B0/B1/B2 reddit 实际 entropy 才决定 H10 命运。这可能 differ — `success` 漂移 + B1/B2 capability 引入会改 label distribution。

### 151.6 Reviewer-defense narrative shift

| | v3 narrative | v4 narrative |
|---|---|---|
| Pre-data lock substrate | archive | Phase 1a fresh data train folds (rules locked, triggers post-launch) |
| Archive role | "preregistration lock substrate" (claim wrong) | "correlated-population sanity check" (honest) |
| Brownlee/Hastie defense | "thresholds frozen pre-data on archive" (fails on task-ID overlap) | "thresholds set by literature default + archive sanity confirms direction" (passes) |
| H10 DEFER framing | "triggered on archive, pre-data locked" (HARKing risk) | "rule pre-data locked, trigger on fresh data" (honest conditional) |

### 151.7 Distance shift (v3 → v4)

- Workshop R3: 0.88 → 0.90
- Mid-tier R2: 0.50 → 0.55 (honest framing 让 R2 reviewer trust 涨)
- Top-tier R1: 0.20 → 0.22 (G2 / G4 / G7 还限, 但 methodology hole 补)

v4 不加 capability / contribution, 只是补 methodology hole。但 reviewer-defense **net stronger** 即便 pre-data decision artifacts 更少 (eg H10 viability 从 pre-launch 决定 → post-launch 决定)。

### 151.8 Cross-AI value proposition 实证 (cycle 总结)

v1 → v4 共 4 轮 hostile review:
- v1→v2: Claude /stress + codex /codex-stress + gemini /gemini-stress 3-AI 12 findings
- v2→v3: user 3 OOB (P0-8 / P0-9 / P0-10) — 3 AI 都漏
- v3→v4: user 1 OOB (P0-11 archive ≠ independent test) — 3 AI + Claude self-stress 都漏

**4 个 OOB findings 全部 user-caught**, 3 AI 一个没抓到。Pattern: user 持完整 project context (task ID 复用 / Cat audit derivation / has_ref_image task-attached / hijack mechanism evidence) 能 surface 跨-doc OOB attack; 3 AI 即使 read 全部 prompt 的 artifacts 也很难 surface 这种 contextual OOB。

**结构性 takeaway**: cross-AI stress 是 floor, 不是 ceiling — user 持完整 mental context 的 OOB 抓取能力**超过** 3-AI synthesis。所以 design synthesis workflow **不能停在 3-AI 完成**, 必须有 user 介入 review 的 turn。这是 design-mode /stress 跟 audit-mode /stress 的核心 process 区别。

## 153. Router design v3 → v6 + 2-round cross-AI pre-fire stress + Pareto reformulation (2026-05-16) [design][finding][infra] #design #finding #infra

Router design 在一天内 4 个 iteration land (v3 → v4 → v5 → v6), 由 2 轮 cross-AI hostile stress + 用户 OOB catches + empirical sanity sim 共同 drive. **核心 reframe**: paper §6 router 架构从 "rule-based vs learned 二选一" 变成 "**2-layer cascade (LR prior + verbose-reactive)** 上叠 **Pareto (Cost, SR) 非主导 estimand**", 跟 paper-1 title "Cost-Aware Routing for Web Usage Agents" 完全 align.

### 153.1 v3 (rule-based prior threshold cherry-pick) → v4 (Option C: archive demoted)

`router_archive_diagnostic.py` G1/G2/G4 verdicts 原拟作 preregistration §C lock substrate. 用户 catch (OOB 4): archive 用 same task IDs as Phase 1a (cls 0-233 / red 0-209), 是 pattern leak 不是 independent test. v4 demotes archive 为 correlated-population sanity-check; H10 DEFER trigger + anchor-flicker fallback 转用 Phase 1a fresh-data 评估. 5 retract/reframe edits applied to preregistration §C. 详 §151 chronicle.

### 153.2 v4 → v5 (2-layer compose: learned L1 + verbose-reactive L2)

P1 v3 实证 archive simulation 暴露 P1 rule **决策树退化** — `dom_size > 12000` + `dom_complexity > 500` 阈值在 cls/red **全 fire 0%** (cls max 5512, red max 6963 chars). P1 v3 ≡ always_phantom_som on archive. 用户提出 reframe: 把 P2 改成 L1 (learned task-prior), 新增 L2 (verbose reactive runtime trigger) — cascade compose. Anchored to `auroc_cross_condition.csv` published fig0g AUROC (verbalized + max_repeat_streak + url_revisit_count 信号 0.7-0.85 range in 13-19 cells). v5 spec landed `proposals_v5.md` + L1 archive sim `l1_archive_simulation.py` (3 class-imbalance variants 测).

L1 archive 实证: Variant A (uniform LR) collapse to always-predict-dom (predicted); Variant B (balanced) **cls +2.56pp / red -4.76pp** site-asymmetric; Variant C (binary + hand rule) all underperform. v5 §2.5 改 "site-conditional L1": cls LR + red phantom_som hardcoded default (后被 P0-2 标 marketing spin).

### 153.3 v5 → v6 (Pareto + phantom-only verbose + 72-cond)

**第二轮 cross-AI pre-fire stress** (codex 11 findings 3 OOB + gemini 11 findings 4 OOB, 第一轮 75-sec milestone audit 太浅 user flag 后 dispatch). 关键 catches:
- **Codex pre-fire #2 OOB (P0-7)**: `p79/experiment/conditions.py:90` Phase 1a 生成器硬编码 `router_on=False`; v5 §3.4 声称 "Phase 1a measures L2" 但 conditions 不 enable router → execution-substrate hole
- **Codex #1 + Gemini #1 双 AI OOB (P0-8)**: paper title "Cost-Aware Routing" vs H9/H10 SR-only estimand = **false advertising**. 没 Pareto / cost-utility / Lagrangian
- **Codex #10 (P0-9)**: `aggregate_phase1_prereg_gate.py:178` `_fe_pool()` floor SE ≤ 0 → 1e-9, degenerate cells (e.g. P-SoM-only=0) infinite weight 主宰 FE pool — paper §1 hero claim infrastructure 可被任一 cell hijack
- **Gemini #4 (P1-17)**: §1 hook (phantom 4-fold drop-in cost/latency claim) vs §6 mechanism (L2 verbose runtime overhead) **coherence collapse** — L2 destroys §1 latency benefit
- **Codex #11 (P1-13)**: `aggregate_cost_electricity.py:104` else branch silently 把 B2 当 B1 处理, paper §6 B2 cost story 结构缺失

**L2 partial-trajectory AUROC sanity sim** (`l2_partial_traj_auroc.py`) 实证 confirm F1: 8/12 cells k=3 partial AUROC < 0.65; k=5 viable 6/11 cells; **phantom modes all viable at k=5** (5/5), baseline modes only 1-3/6 — surfaced as paper §5 mechanism sub-finding "phantom modes' verbose signal saturates faster due to truncated-input forcing early commitment".

### 154.2 Q4 walk-back: repeated stratified 5-fold × 10 repeats

cls archive N=234, 5-fold = 47 test/fold + balanced LR + 8 features → 单 5-fold variance 大. v7 改用 **repeated stratified 5-fold × 10 repeats** (50 train-test pairs per variant). 1h script change.

实际数字对比 (cls Variant B vs always_phantom_som 15.81%):

| Method | cls Variant B SR | Δ vs phantom_som | CI |
|---|---|---|---|
| Single 5-fold (v6) | 18.38% | +2.56pp | [13.68, 23.50] (47-task fold variance) |
| **Repeated 5-fold × 10 (v7)** | **17.84%** | **+2.02pp** | **[16.30, 19.42]** (50-pair pooled) |

CI lower bound 16.30 > baseline 15.81, **Variant B cls 仍 statistically beat phantom_som default**. Magnitude 衰减 0.54pp 反映 single-fold optimism.

红 Variant B 仍 -3.95pp (从 -4.76pp 略升), 但 lower bound 9.05 < 14.29 = 仍 fail Pareto vs phantom_som. **Red learned router 仍 collapse to majority on text-dominated archive**, paper §6 site-asymmetric viability finding 保留.

**Paper §6 framing v7-locked**:
- Archive sim 数字 (repeated 5-fold × 10) 作为 development sanity supplementary table
- Paper-grade main number 锁 **Phase 1a LOCO** (Leave-One-Cell-Out: train 5 cells, test 1, repeat 6 times) — Phase 1a 6 cells × N=200-240 = ~1200-1400 task pool 之后可做
- 双层 honest disclosure: "archive +2.02pp cls development; Phase 1a LOCO +Y.YYpp paper-grade"

### 158.6 Why "hard-delete" 而非 "selective-retain alias"

2026-05-14 §139.8 时 design 是 "alias 保留 == raw counterpart 保 output-schema 稳定"(memory L49)。User overrule 2026-05-16 = 这套 selective-retain 反而是 reviewer-trip vector:
- 字段名 KEY 携带历史语义 (`adjusted_success` 暗示 post-hoc adjusted),VALUE 是 canonical → reviewer 拿 JSON 看到 `adjusted_success` 与 `success` 恒等会困惑 "为啥两字段一样?"
- `fig0b_fp_rate_per_mode` 整 figure 围绕已退役 FP rate (post-§139.8 always 0) → paper figure 画全 0 条 → reviewer "为啥所有 mode FP=0?"
- `_mark_false_positives` 函数 docstring 自己说 "thin alias-setter" → reviewer 读 grep 找 FP detection 找到一个 "always returns 0" 的函数 → cargo-cult perception
- 3-AI 互验 P0-1 denominator transition gap = 同款问题:retire 时只 sweep code path,narrative footprint (docstring / report prose / paper §4 hero table) 没跟上 → 3 处 surface 数字不自洽

Hard-delete 比 alias-retain 更诚实:retire 就 retire,output schema break 一次性发生,fresh aggregator run 写新 schema,legacy `docs/archive/analysis_pre_2026-05-15/` 永久存档不再混用。

User cross-talk insight 同构性:

### 178.4 User reframing learning — B-91 precedent argument

User initially said "其他 vwa paper 也是这样" (don't fix, match upstream). My first response leaned (a) disclose-only. User then countered: "但是 llm fuzzy match 会有 na fp, 这个我就是上游 patch 的, 所以理论上来说, 这个严格 string 是不是也应该修复?" — point: B-91 patching upstream is precedent that "P79 patches upstream evaluator bugs + discloses divergence". My (a) was inconsistent with B-91 stance. **Lesson**: when applying "match upstream" defense, check existing P79 precedents — if any prior fix patched upstream + disclosed, the precedent IS to patch + disclose, not to preserve buggy upstream. **Recovery**: revise to (b-fix) with user's "no ambiguous middle" constraint.

### 178.5 Cross-paper SR comparability — paper §3.5 evaluator-patch policy

Post-B-535 fix, P79 evaluator is strict-negative-first while VWA / WebArena-Verified / PAE / Aviator-Web etc continue to use upstream's `"correct" in response` substring matcher. This adds a 3rd P79 evaluator divergence point (after `gpt-4o-mini` vs `gpt-4-1106-preview` judge MODEL choice + B-91 empty-pred guard). Paper §3.5 should articulate the "P79 evaluator-patch policy: patch upstream evaluator bugs + disclose divergence; do NOT preserve buggy upstream for direct comparability when bug systematically inflates SR; rely on within-paper paired comparisons for internal validity, NOT cross-paper SR absolute comparison". This policy was implicit in B-91 fix but should be explicit prose for reviewer audit.

**Workflow lessons** (encoded for future audit cycles):
1. **Comment-vs-code drift in claim verification** — B-640 mint_run_id comment promised `%N nanoseconds` but `date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S` had no `%N`. Always grep the actual `date` format string against the comment claim.
2. **Bash parameter expansion is NOT python f-string** — `${var!r}` is `${var@op}` form with invalid op `r` → bad substitution. Python heredoc embedded in bash needs env-var pass-through not literal interpolation.
3. **`set -e` mid-script flip changes errexit for ALL subsequent lines** — explicit guard logic written assuming no errexit becomes dead code. Decide errexit policy at script top once.
4. **Substring break-first ordering is structurally wrong** — longest-prefix-first or structural parse beats `for site in $LIST; do if substring; then; fi; done` (WA shopping site-key disaster).
5. **Empty string in case "OK" branch silently passes failures** — `case ... in ...|"") ;; *) FATAL` lets `vwa_env_remote.sh` source failure (empty URLs) pretend everything's fine. Separate explicit "" → FATAL branch.
6. **Sibling propagation across 4-queue-script + lib pattern** — any new gate / env / arg must propagate to all 5 callers. Today's audit caught 6+ propagation defects (B-638 B2 alias / B-644 ntfy env / B-645 positional args / B-647 WA reset / earlier B-230 series).
7. **Silent skip on benchmark-specific branch is paper-grade-fatal** — replace with hard-fail until proper gate exists (B-647 WA skip ≠ "supported on WA, just different mechanism").
8. **TOCTOU pgrep collision check needs lock** — flock-based per-(site,benchmark) lock spans check + launch + sentinel; non-blocking acquire → second-chain FATAL exit better than infinite-wait.
9. **History data is paper-grade evidence**: 23/24 historical paper-grade fires were 100% exact (cls/red 234/210 + B0_dom_shopping 99.78% pre-fix). Sentinel "90% threshold" was lazy default not reality-driven. Empirical history > developer intuition.

A1.13 introduced 0 test regression.

New order: SHA-comparison first; branch check demoted to WARN-only (unless mismatch + branch=`HEAD` → silent pass, the canonical OSF reproducibility workflow). Allows reviewers to `git checkout <pinned-sha>` directly without preflight FAIL.

Non-ancestor mismatch → hard FAIL (catches force-push / branch reset). `EXPECTED_SHA_STRICT=1` env reverts to exact-match for OSF audit runs.

**Lessons (continued from §189 #7)**:
8. **"Committed" gates must check git-state, not file-state** — `ls $path` answers "is this file on disk?" not "is this paper-grade evidence?". OSF reproducibility audit examines git log + diff status. Future provenance / lock-file gates: `git ls-files --error-unmatch` + `git diff --quiet HEAD --` are 2-line additions that close entire classes of "scaffolded fingerprint" bugs.
9. **SHA-pin gates should be forward-compatible by default** — hard-coded SHA equality breaks every time anyone advances the submodule. `git merge-base --is-ancestor expected HEAD` lets forward sync pass while preserving the reproducibility guarantee (pinned code is reachable from HEAD). Strict mode via env override for OSF audit runs. This pattern generalizes to any version-pinned dependency lock.
10. **Detached HEAD = canonical reproducibility checkout, not pathological state** — Reviewers cloning your pin via `git checkout <SHA>` ALWAYS land in detached HEAD. Branch-name equality check at correct SHA is backwards for paper-grade. Branch is mutable social metadata (`p79-patches` could be renamed tomorrow); SHA is the immutable evidence.

Phase 1a `launch all` is now **paper-grade fire-safe** for the substrate dimensions Chunks (a)+(b)+(c) cover; (c) specifically addresses reviewer reproducibility audit which is often the FIRST audit thing they check.

**Lessons (continued from §191 #10)**:
11. **Lock coordination across nested invocations requires explicit env handshake** — naive double-acquire fails because FD-N lock on same file blocks even from same process via different FD. `P79_CHAIN_LOCK_HELD="${site}:${benchmark}"` env from parent → leaf checks before acquire. Future nested-flock pattern: parent exports lock identity, child detects + skips, cleanup on parent release. Avoids subtle "everything works when child invoked standalone, fails inside chain" regression class.
12. **Static analysis tests > behavior tests for cross-script invariants** — testing "queue_baseline.sh actually calls acquire_site_lock" via parametrized grep is more reliable + faster than subprocess-fork-and-verify. 5 tests covering 4 leaf scripts + lib + queue_chain coordination = 200ms total. Behavioral tests for the lock contention path would require multi-process forking + race timing → flaky.
13. **`curl -L` is paper-grade-grade default for any notification call** — curl's no-follow-redirect default is a CLI usability tradeoff irrelevant to production reliability. Always pass `-L` for outgoing notification webhooks unless you specifically want to detect redirects.
14. **HTML comment allowlist > deny-list / regex broadening** — for "find any X" gates, broad regex + opt-in allowlist (`<!-- ALLOW: reason -->`) beats narrow phrase match because (a) catches future variants without re-editing the gate, (b) intentional placeholders are explicit + visible to reviewers, (c) "I forgot the magic phrase" pre-fix failure mode disappears.

### 196.9 Reviewer lessons distilled (5)

1. **Strategic high-leverage close > tactical fix accumulation** — Q4 "digest 全退役" (Option α) closes 5 项 with 3h work vs ~5h to fix 4 individual digest bugs. **User cross-talk insight (challenge premise vs accept current framing) beats individual finding triage**. /stress workflow should explicitly surface "does this whole layer need to exist?" as a top-tier user-decision option when 3+ bugs cluster in one subsystem.

2. **Cold-start re-audit catches what 7+ prior cycles missed** — A1.15 2026-05-16 had 11 fixes; cold-start 2026-05-17 found 16 NEW unique findings = pre-fix cycles structurally missed paper-grade surface (pgrep self-match codex F1 + 6-layer cross-component gemini F2 + datetime crash codex F4). **Cold-start vs incremental re-read** is materially different mode.

3. **Empirical spot-check is non-negotiable for paper-grade prose** — B-765 "2-3s" survived 7 cycles because nobody measured. v7.5 length/byte/duration spot-check rule should extend to **"every numeric claim in disclosure prose"**, not just code commit numeric values.

4. **Marketing-claim ↔ structural-reality gap is paper-grade attack surface** — Gemini F2 "6-layer only 4 explicit" was design-claim audit (1-AI gemini lineage strength, predicting paper §3 reviewer audit). **Cross-component code-site disclosure (Option E) stronger than claim weakening (Option A)** when cross-component is the truth. Pattern: design claims that are *partially* true need precision disclosure, not 全部 retraction.

5. **6th parallel-session B-# collision is now structural** — high-to-low atomic sed rebase pattern in single batch (source/target disjoint) is muscle memory. Reserve B-# buffer ≥ 10 + pre-commit grep+tail of catalog avoids 80% of collision; remaining 20% (e.g., this Chunk (b) collision with A1.17 capturing B-744~B-760 between my reservation + commit) requires post-edit rebase. **New pattern lesson**: "stage catalog stub immediately at TaskCreate" rather than reserve-during-audit-window — catalog file presence makes collision visible.

### 197.7 Reviewer lessons distilled (7)

1. **Sibling-class type defense scales to ALL data-flow positions** — A1.8 B-283 fixed string-truthy at one position 24h ago; A1.9 cold-start found 4 sibling positions (numeric hero / lazy load / mid-eval / aggregator entry). One fix-batch never closes class — sibling sweep is structural requirement.

2. **Python `bool` is `int` subclass recurring vector** — gemini C1 + A1.8 B-735 + A1.9 B-782 all centered on this. Paper-grade audit should standardize `isinstance(v, bool) and not isinstance(v, (int, float))` order check; `bool` must be excluded BEFORE numeric check.

3. **Helper functions hide contract violations** — B-784 codex catch: `load_episode_summary_strict.reject_needs_reevaluation` covered only 1 of 3 aggregator call-sites. Public-API contract enforcement must span ALL invocation paths — runner live + rederive + canonical analysis.

4. **Cold-start audit catches what fix-batch builds skip** — 2026-05-16 A1.9 22 fixes felt comprehensive; cold-start 24h later found 17 NEW unique attack vectors = 78% of A1.9 surface was UNTOUCHED by visible fix-batch. Audit-cycle pattern: fix-batch produces visible defenses, but SURVIVAL probability of attacks-not-in-batch is the harder estimate.

5. **Root-cause fix > symptom fix when symptom = expensive batch crash** — P1-9 (B-793 preflight probe) chose root-cause (option d, 1.5h) over symptom-quarantine (option a, 4h) because preflight surfaces init-fail at 10s probe rather than crashing 36-condition batch on condition #1.

## 198. /stress v7.8 spec — Phase 4 claim-realness + runtime capture mandatory + silent-fall-back ban (2026-05-17) [infra] #infra

User feedback 2026-05-17: "现在的 skill stress, 没有检查其他 ai 输出的问题是否 real 的 verify 阶段; 然后如果其他 ai 的输出时间过短, 没有重试功能, 一般都会 silent fall back scope."

**Root-cause diagnosis** (两个独立缺口):
1. Pre-v7.8 Post-flight verification had Phase 1/2/3 (I/O sanity / depth-scope / runtime) — all are **shape verification**, none verify whether cited `file:line` / code-symbol / quoted prose / specific number is real. Cross-AI lineages routinely hallucinate (Gemini especially on numbers — already disclaimed in `/gemini-stress` "What this skill is NOT"). Hallucinated findings reach unified bug list, waste user review budget on phantom bugs.
2. Phase 3 runtime sanity table had "<1 min on any scope = re-run as-is" rule, but no enforced runtime capture → `run_in_background` async notify pattern loses dispatch timestamp → Phase 3 silent-pass → finding-count fall back. Empirical pattern: "milestone scope, wallclock=40s, 2 findings" → Claude implicit re-classifies as "spot-check, 2 findings ≥ spot min 3, accept" instead of retrying.

**Fixes landed** (3-file patch, master + 2 components):

- **master `.claude/skills/stress/SKILL.md`**:
  - New **"Runtime capture (MANDATORY v7.8)"** section as Phase 3 prerequisite — dispatch records `START` + `pid` + `scope` to `$OUTPUT.dispatch.meta`; harness completion notify appends `wallclock_sec=`. Missing meta → Phase 3 = MISSING, MANDATORY auto-retry.
  - Phase 3 HARD detection rules — `wallclock < 60s` OR `< 1/3 pre-declared scope lower bound` → MANDATORY auto-retry; **🚫 Silent-fall-back BAN** explicit (pre-declared scope = contract; do not auto-downgrade scope band silently).
  - New **"Phase 4 — Claim realness spot-check"** section — sample N=max(2, ceil(0.3×total)) findings (prioritize P0 + OOB); verify cited `file:line` / code-symbol / quoted prose / specific number / cross-file pattern. Hallucinated finding → per-finding `⚠️ Phase 4` tag in diff, NO whole-audit retry (re-rolling dice with same lineage). Triage exception: 5+ hallucinations / 7 sampled = audit-level corruption → MANDATORY retry per Phase 3 silent-fast equivalent.
  - Retry decision matrix — new rows: "Silent-fast (wallclock < 60s OR < 1/3 scope lower bound)" / "Runtime capture missing" / "Phase 4 per-finding hallucination" with explicit MANDATORY-vs-NO-retry triage.

- **component `.claude/skills/codex-stress/SKILL.md`** — 1-line reference back to master canonical (per "master wins" pattern); codex-specific note = `file:line` + symbol + cross-file pattern citations are highest-ROI Phase 4 sample target.

- **component `.claude/skills/gemini-stress/SKILL.md`** — 1-line reference back to master; gemini-specific note = number citations (`AUROC`, `pp`, `4×`) are highest-ROI Phase 4 sample target (per existing "it'll hallucinate numbers" disclaimer).

3 SKILL.md versioning entries (v7.8) added with same driver text + cross-reference. Master canonical = SKILL.md `.claude/skills/stress/SKILL.md`; replicas under `docs/checkpoints/process/{stress,codex_stress,gemini_stress}_skill_replica.md` NOT yet synced (skill `.md` files are gitignored; replicas are git-tracked snapshots — sync deferred until user requests).

**Why hard-constraint, not soft-suggestion**: silent fall-back violates pre-declared scope contract that Claude signed at Phase 0 self-audit ("Scope: ..." line). Soft suggestion would lose to forward-progress mode (rationalize partial output as "scope was actually smaller"). Hard rule + auto-retry trigger + ban removes the rationalization path.

**Pending follow-ups**:
- Replicas (`docs/checkpoints/process/*_skill_replica.md`) sync if user wants git-tracked paper trail of v7.8
- Memory file `reference_*.md` references to v7.8 (current memory refs say v7.1, not auto-updated)
- Per-finding hallucination rate stats — first 2-3 audits with Phase 4 active will reveal empirical hallucination rate per lineage; could feed back into v7.9 sampling strategy

### 200.3 Architecture insights (paper-grade design lessons)

1. **Caller↔script契约 is high-overlap target class** — 3 of 6 P0 findings (B-822, B-823, B-825) are "snapshot writes signal field but no caller reads" pattern. The cold-start re-audit value is forcing the reviewer to walk caller integration paths that the original fix-batch's "script-internal logic" framing missed. The new `snapshot_has_critical_errors(snap) → (has_critical, reasons)` helper unifies the 4 fail-loud signals (`_critical_error` / `evaluator_code.incomplete` / `models[m].divergence != "match"` / `vwa_sbom.match_lock=False`); paper-1 caller `run_experiment.py:64-100` + paper-2 caller `run_stage2b_continuation_pilot.py:245-285` both wired through this helper for symmetric paper-grade gating.
2. **Prose↔code contract layer is gemini's dominant value-prop** — 5 of 7 gemini findings (B-824 / B-833 / B-838 + 2 partial overlap) target prose claims without code backing. Code-side AI (codex) shines on caller-integration audit (5/7 codex findings); design-side AI (Claude) shines on field-semantics + invariant-test gaps (5/10 Claude findings). 3-AI persona separation pays — each lineage covers structurally different attack surface that other 2 won't surface.
3. **OSF replayability claim layer needs symmetric cold-start audit per release** — every prose-line saying "snapshot includes X" / "verifies Y" / "aborts on divergence Z" deserves a "what code path executes that contract?" question. This batch surfaces 4 such claims (B-822 tree-hash chain / B-824 reference_images / B-838 generation_manifest / B-833 judge env) where prereg / locked_versions / osf_lock_manifest assumed implementation that wasn't there. The pattern is structural — every paper-grade release commit could trigger an `assert each "snapshot/captures/records" prose phrase maps to grep-findable code` invariant test.
4. **Cold-start re-audit empirically catches ~70% structurally-invisible attack surfaces vs prior fix-batch** — 2026-05-16 A1.16 closed 7 findings on same 2-file scope; 24h later 17 new unique gaps found. Survival rate of attacks not in fix-batch is the harder estimate. Same pattern across A1.9 (17 new from 22 prior) / A1.15 (16 new from 22 prior) / A1.2 (22 new from 11 prior).
5. **Tree-hash chain SBOM contract is now end-to-end live** — prereg §7 line 568 "Each Phase 1a paper-grade run includes a provenance snapshot that re-evaluates (1)/(2)/(3); divergence aborts the run" was the highest-confidence paper-grade bug (3-AI overlap). The new `_vwa_submodule_integrity()` recomputes Layer 1 (HEAD `1c3a615...`) + Layer 2 (upstream base `89f5af2...` reachable) + Layer 3 (tree-hash chain `5c6c5f6...`); caller post-call inspect raises `SystemExit(2)` on divergence; pytest invariant lock. Force-push rewriting `p79-patches` history between lock + run time now detectable + fatal.

### 202.3 B-846 reference image `parents[3]` + `_extract_site` anchored regex (codex Mode B P1-3 OOB)

**Pre-fix DOUBLE-DEAD failure**:
1. `glm_batch_digest.py:255 Path(__file__).parent.parent.parent / "external" / "visualwebarena"` → `scripts/external/visualwebarena` (PATH DOES NOT EXIST). Correct = `parents[3]` → repo root.
2. `_extract_site:957-962` always returned `""` regardless of case content. Gates `_load_reference_images_b64` early-exit at `if not site`.

Even if caller passed site explicitly, path resolution failed. From live sidecar (calls _extract_site → empty), site never set, reference images NEVER load. **Paper §3 prose claims "DOM mode uses task reference images for visual-match diagnosis" — FALSIFIED in current code path.** Reviewer reading code + paper sees clean prose↔code attack vector.

**Fix**:
1. `parents[2]` → `parents[3]`. Spot-checked: `parents[3]/external/visualwebarena` exists; `parents[2]/external/visualwebarena` does NOT.
2. `_extract_site` walks inference chain: `case["site"]` explicit valid → `case["run_dir"]` anchored regex `_<site>_<8-digit>` (longest-first `shopping_admin → classifieds → reddit → shopping` to avoid substring collision) → fallback `""`. Same anchored pattern as `glm_cell_autoupdate.py:135`.

**Paper-grade impact**: closes paper §3 reference-image-diagnosis prose↔code mismatch attack.

### 202.4 B-847 `_extract_balanced_json` helper replacing rfind (codex Mode B P1-9 OOB)

**Pre-fix**: `_call_glm_chat` reasoning fallback at L99-100 + L108-109 used `rfind("{")` / `rfind("}")` to extract JSON from GLM thinking-model `reasoning_content`. For nested outputs `{"failure_diagnosis":[{...}, {...}], "root_cause":"X"}`, rfind returns LAST `{` (start of last inner element) + LAST `}` (end of outer) = malformed mid-array slice → json.loads fails → retry burns → GLM_FAILED noise.

**Fix**: `_extract_balanced_json(text) -> Optional[str]` walks forward from first `{` tracking brace depth + string state (handles `"..."` with `\"` escape). Returns OUTERMOST balanced `{...}` substring, greedy (first balanced object found). Replaces both rfind callsites.

**Edge cases tested** (10 invariants in test_stress_a1_15b_chunk_beta.py):
- Simple flat: `{"a":1}` ✓
- Nested outer wins: `{"outer":[{"inner":1}, {"inner":2}]}` returns full outer ✓
- String with braces: `{"msg":"this has { in it"}` braces don't shift depth ✓
- Escaped quote: `{"msg":"a \"quoted{\" } b"}` handled ✓
- Unbalanced: `{"a": 1` → None ✓
- Empty / no braces: → None ✓
- Multiple top-level: returns FIRST balanced object ✓
- Realistic GLM markdown fence (prose + ```json ... ``` + prose): parseable + json.loads succeeds ✓

**Paper-grade impact**: GLM digest retry efficiency + downstream JSON parse reliability. Boundary impact on paper §5 mechanism prose if any narrative cites GLM-categorized failure modes (currently uses fallback-bucket counts, not specific GLM categories — but closes the boundary).

### 204.3 B-856 atomic state writes + fail-loud load + mandatory digest flock (codex Mode B P1-10 OOB)

**Three callsites** (all in glm sidecar substrate):

1. `glm_diagnosis_sidecar._save_state(L209)` — pre-fix direct `write_text()` non-atomic. Cron crash mid-write left half-written state JSON → either silent `{}` next tick (pre-B-856) or fail-loud (post-B-856). Fix: temp file in same dir + `os.replace()` atomic rename. Cleans `.tmp` on any error (preserves prior state).

2. `glm_diagnosis_sidecar._load_state(L200)` — pre-fix silent `return {}` on JSON corruption. Contaminated-episode tracking + GLM trigger counters silently lost across cron ticks. Fix: raise `RuntimeError` on `json.JSONDecodeError` with line/col + manual-repair instruction. Missing-file path still returns `{}` (legitimate first-run). Matches A1.15 B-393 fail-loud pattern.

3. `glm_batch_digest._append_jsonl(L1137-1141)` — pre-fix no file lock. Two concurrent operator runs both computed `done_keys` at startup, then BOTH appended same `(cid, tid)` → duplicate JSONL rows → count-based aggregators double-counted → paper §3 phantom mode narrative magnitudes potentially doubled. Fix: mandatory `fcntl.flock(LOCK_EX)` before write; blocks until lock acquired. Fail-loud OSError if filesystem rejects flock (rare NFS edge).

**Verification**: 8 new pytest invariants — atomic-save (no `.tmp` leftover) / repeated-write idempotent / missing-file empty return / corrupt-file RuntimeError / save+load roundtrip / mandatory LOCK_EX present in source.

### 205.7 Reviewer lessons distilled (paper-grade design language)

1. **`flock` is not a mutex against `unlink`** — POSIX advisory flock blocks concurrent open+lock from peer processes BUT does NOT defend against `os.unlink(path)` from a different process. 3 of 5 P0/P1 race vectors hit this asymmetry. Deletion-intent rename pattern (rename-then-async-reap, B-863) is the correct primitive when "delete a path another process may be writing" is needed.
2. **`setsid nohup` detached runners + leaf trap = lock-free runtime window** — standard "launch-time gate" model breaks at runtime. P0-1 (B-858) is a launch-time gate hardening; runner-lifetime lease (P0-2 Option B) is the architecturally clean solution, deferred per fire timing. Tells future cycles where the architectural debt lives.
3. **Fire-and-forget Popen has zero failure surface** — pair every fire-and-forget with (a) launch-time .lock marker + (b) success-path .done marker + (c) stale-lock detection at next cron tick. B-861 + B-865 land this pattern; should generalize to other Popen-with-DEVNULL sites in codebase.

### 207.7 Reviewer lessons distilled — 设计层 audit pattern

1. **3-AI overlap 落在 deep methodology bugs** — P0-1 (packaging) + P0-2 (null hypothesis) 全是需要 stats-background mindset 的攻击. 三家独立都打到 = paper §1 在 NeurIPS-tier reviewer 面前的最大裸露面. 不是巧合, 是 paper hero claim 本身 frame 成 "empirical contribution" 但 substrate 是 "design constraint" 的结构错位.
2. **`-o` 标志在 codex apply_patch 工作流下有坑** — codex 用 `apply_patch` 创建文件后, `-o` 在 final assistant message 阶段覆写文件内容为 "I wrote the audit to <path>" 指针消息. 真实 audit 在 trace log 内嵌 diff. 需要 awk-extract 还原. 未来 codex dispatch 可考虑:
   - 不用 `-o`, 让 codex `apply_patch` 直接写文件 (但需明确 prompt 指示)
   - 或用 `-o` + 明确 prompt 指示 "final message = audit content, do not use apply_patch"
3. **Gemini line# 仍有偏移** — F1 cited line 88 actual 89, F5 cited line 37 actual 17. 但 verbatim quote 匹配 → spot-check 通过. 这跟 A1.9 memory caveat 一致, 不是 hallucination.
4. **Phase 4 spot-check 重要性再确认** — Mode B+C 都有 numeric specificity 要求 (file:line + 数字), Phase 4 5/5 verified (3 codex + 2 gemini), 0 hallucinations. v7.8 spec Phase 4 强制要求 sample N=max(2, 0.3×findings_count) 已经是 calibrated reasonable 下限.
5. **设计层 attack 修复全是 prose + 部分 analysis** — 跟 §A1 code-layer 不同, prose rewrite 主导 + 1 个 analysis code module (permutation null) 才是 paper-grade defensible. 不能纯 prose, 否则 reviewer "可以但你做了吗" → P0-2 必须真有 `--permute-marginal-null` CLI flag + 测试.

### §221.1 用户 directive 修正 — archive 不能进 prereg

Audit 中段, Claude Mode A 初版 recommendation = "demote H10 to exploratory based on archive sim FAIL projection" — 拉出 `l1_archive_simulation_2026-05-16.md` 数据 (Variant B balanced LR: cls +2.02pp / red -3.95pp), 投影到 6-cell FE pool ≈ -0.97pp null + K-of-6 = 3/6 < 5/6 threshold, 论证 archive 已显示 router 不 viable → 应该 demote H10.

**用户 immediate retract** ("对，你这个反驳是对的，而且很关键"): archive 不是 prereg substrate (`router/archive_diagnostic_2026-05-16.md` 自己声明), 也不是 demote H10 的依据 — 如果当前 E'' router 没在 archive 里按同一 protocol 跑过, archive verdict 不能判 H10 死刑. 用户指向**正确的解决路径**: 不要 demote, 而是**重写 K-of-6 为 fixed-cell operational robustness gate (NOT a binomial significance test at α=0.05)**, 同时**删除所有 archive-derived rationale from prereg**.

这个修正同时消除 3 个 P0 OOB attack: §C5 phantom cross-doc ref + K-of-6 vs K-of-N doctrine collision + §C5 archive-data-derived estimand selection.

### §221.2 Two-layer operational deployment gate (locked B-1550)

新 §H10 PRIMARY framing (`preregistration.md:209-233`):

- **Cell-level (statistical)**: per cell paired bootstrap B=1000 seed=42 on (Cost, SR); cell passes if router Pareto non-dominated vs 5 single-mode baselines in ≥95% bootstrap replicates. Task-level paired-bootstrap *within* cell — per-task labels are resampled unit, NOT cells across grid.
- **Grid-level (operational robustness criterion)**: H10 deployable iff ≥5 of 6 pre-registered cells pass cell-level. **5/6 threshold = fixed-cell operational deployment criterion, NOT a binomial significance test**. 6 cells = complete pre-registered decision family per decision "3A" finite-population framing; prereg doesn't interpret 6 cells as random sample → binomial inference incoherent. §2.4 K-of-N fake-precision retired-as-gate doctrine targets *across-cells binomial inference at α* (inflates Type-I at small N); operational gate is *engineering deployability margin not interpreted as frequentist test* (no across-cells α, no Type-I/II coupling, no "fake precision" of 0.75 vs 0.67 ratio because 5/6=0.833 is exact engineering margin not significance level).

## 228. /stress A1.24 fire-day catastrophe — B-1581 vwa_wrapper asyncio guard hard-fail → soft replace (2026-05-18 ~13:30-14:30 BST) [bug][infra] #bug #infra

Phase 1a Pass-1 fire launched ~12:20 BST post-§227 closure. cls B0 dom + red B0 dom in parallel chains. **Fire-day catastrophe within 5 min**: cls B0 dom condition burned 110 tasks (task=29..task=110) with 324 `RuntimeError: VWAWrapper.reset() detected an active asyncio loop. See B-159 in _lazy_init for context.` errors. EVERY task post-task-0 failed immediately at 0 steps. Red B0 dom (still on task=0 busy-wait) would have hit the same pattern at task=1 — kill-ordered before scale-out.

**Root cause**: B-159 (2026-05-16) added a fail-loud guard at `p79/envs/vwa_wrapper.py:_lazy_init` (L164-177) + `:reset` (L204-213) checking `_asyncio.get_running_loop()` and raising if a loop is bound. Intent (per B-159 comment): "Phase 1a callers never have an active loop; this guard mostly catches pytest-asyncio / notebook / service-runner contexts that should isolate via subprocess."

**Empirical reality**: VWA submodule `external/visualwebarena/browser_env/async_envs.py:114/121/160` uses `asyncio.run()` for per-step browser_env reset/step/close. `asyncio.run()` creates a fresh event loop, runs coroutine, closes loop — but leaves the loop reference as thread-local default via `set_event_loop`. Subsequent `get_running_loop()` from sync Python on the same thread returns the stale (closed) loop reference → B-159 hard-fail raises.

Task 0 succeeded because lazy_init ran fresh (clean state). Task 0's step loop called `_env.step()` → `async_envs.py:160 asyncio.run(astep)` → stale-binding installed. Task 1 reset hit the guard → raise → episode benchmark_noise with 0 steps. All 109 subsequent tasks repeated.

**Why 2-week gap to discovery**: B-159 landed 2026-05-16 during A1.3 v8 codex prose-audit. Phase 1a fire was paused pre-2026-05-14 (advisor sync + Gemma3-VL nomination). First real production multi-task fire was today (2026-05-18). 2-week prose-validation-only window let hard-fail guard ship without empirical multi-task testing.

**Resolution B-1581** (commit `a4154c5`): replace hard-fail `else: raise` with defensive unconditional reinstall at BOTH `_lazy_init` AND `reset`:
```python
import asyncio as _asyncio
try:
    _stale = _asyncio.get_running_loop()
    logger.warning("B-1581: stale asyncio loop bound to thread; reinstalling. Stale=%r closed=%s",
                   _stale, _stale.is_closed())
except RuntimeError:
    pass  # Clean state
_asyncio.set_event_loop(_asyncio.new_event_loop())
```
Fresh loop installed via `set_event_loop(new_event_loop())` shadows stale binding. Stale-loop detection retained as `logger.warning` for post-fire diagnostic — paper-grade audit greps `B-1581: stale asyncio loop` to count leak frequency.

## 230. OSF DOI doctrine restoration — two-DOI split + pre-outcome-creation lock (2026-05-18 ~14:00 UTC) [design][infra] #design #infra

Triggered by user critique cycle post-§229 + post-fire-launch. While drafting "OSF DOI mint post-Pass-1-data-complete" framework in `next_steps.md` + `advisor_email_draft_2026-05-18.md`, user surfaced **4 OSF best-practice corrections + 1 operational-ordering correction** citing OSF official help docs (help.osf.io/article/330 Welcome to Registrations + help.osf.io/article/626 Simplifying Preregistration).

### Corrections applied (Pre-registration ordering invariant restoration)

1. **"pre-data" 措辞不严谨** → empirically-conditional naming with 3-tier ordering: `pre-outcome-creation` > `pre-outcome-inspection` > `pre-analysis`. Ground-truth check on A100 (UTC 2026-05-18T13:57:22Z) confirmed strongest tier — 0 episode summaries, 0 condition summaries, 0 step JSONLs. Witness file `artifact_existence_check_doi1_20260518T135722Z.txt` (1390 bytes, SHA-256 `e0e591f5b19c0248d4a7274cf8b19e54dbcc01706c859bfcbc2530e84de047d6`, banner-stripped paper-grade-clean) captures empirical state at submission time.

2. **`condition_summary_v2.json` 锚太晚** → first `episodes/*_summary.json` mtime is the earlier outcome-bearing artifact. DOI 1 timestamp must precede per-episode outcome creation, not just condition-level aggregation. Witness script grep covers all 3 tiers (per-episode / condition / per-step) to lock the strongest claim.

3. **Paper drafts archive disclaimer** → `DOI_1_README.md` MANDATORY section: archive placeholder numbers (e.g., `theta_fe=2.336` at k=3 from `meta_phantom_lift.csv` archive pilot) ≠ Phase 1a outcome evidence. Without this disclaimer, OSF reader sees paper §1 hero number in DOI 1 bundle and conflates archive pilot signal with Phase 1a clean-run — **defeats salami-slicing defense via the very layer meant to defend it**.

4. **DOI 2 trigger 措辞** → Pass-1 + Pass-2 + analysis frozen + paper §1-§8 finalized, NOT only "Pass-1 complete". DOI 2 bundle includes Pass-2 router outputs + final analysis + final paper, so trigger must align with bundle content.

5. **OSF approval lag operational ordering** → OSF help.osf.io/article/330 establishes that public registration uses 2-stage approval: (a) submission captures cryptographic UTC timestamp as the witness anchor (immutable from moment of submission), (b) admin approval assigns DOI string (default 48h auto-approval, or sooner via manual click). Paper §4 cite form depends on stage: interim (OSF GUID + submission timestamp), final (DOI string + GUID + submission timestamp).

### Doctrine drift detection

Original 2026-05-05 advisor sync §F.1 outcome decision (实验笔记 §110.3):
> "学生 lean DOI 时间戳 < data unblinding 时间戳让 audit trail ordering 明确"

→ pre-data DOI upload was the operationally locked decision.

**Drift evidence**: `osf_lock_manifest.md §1 Lock blocker` (pre-correction) listed "Phase 1a Pass-1 baseline data complete" as DOI mint gate, which directly contradicts §F.1 pre-data ordering invariant. Between B-1570 doctrine shift (2026-05-18 ~09:30 UTC, advisor-email-retire) and this §230 correction (~14:00 UTC), no explicit retire-§F.1 entry existed — **silent operational doc drift** where the B-1570 commit retired advisor-email-as-lock-gate but did NOT explicitly re-anchor the §F.1 pre-data DOI ordering (which depended on advisor-email-as-gate framing for its operational anchor).

## 236. Fire-3 inflight gallery audit — 3 user questions diagnosed: SR-vs-archive normal / baseline-label fix landed / DOM-screenshot regression B-1760 (2026-05-19 evening UTC) [bug][infra][finding] #bug #infra #finding

User opened the phase1_paper_grade gallery after Fire-3 cls B0 DOM crossed 25 task milestone, raised 3 distinct concerns in one message. All 3 audited and triaged the same evening — 2 are non-issues with documented reasoning, 1 is a real regression with a deferred-fix decision logged.

### 236.1 Q1 — "SR 5/25 = 20% vs archive 差别太大"?

**Verdict**: ✅ NOT a problem. Normal early-task fluctuation within 1σ of archive paper-grade baseline.

**Data anchors** (sanity-checked against multiple sources):
- `compare_b0_b1.py` historical archive entry (笔记 §139.8 backref): B0 cls DOM `raw_sr = 0.1496` (= 14.96%) — paper-grade reference number
- `_archive_pre_fire3/B0_dom_classifieds_smoke6_20260518` (smoke, NOT paper-grade): 8/28 = 28.57% — smoke noise, exclude
- **Current Fire-3 N=25**: 5/25 = 20.0%

**Statistics**: Binomial SE at p=0.15, N=25 is √(0.15×0.85/25) ≈ 7.1pp. Observed 20% vs archive 14.96% delta = +5.04pp = **0.71σ within expected fluctuation**. Trend HIGHER not lower — no contamination signal.

**Sampling-order caveat (paper-grade aware)**: Fire-3 task order is ascending task_id (0..27 with skip 24, no shuffle per `task.exclude_na_tasks` ordered config). cls task 0 = typical listing-search baseline, generally simpler than mid-range. Early-task SR overestimate is a known phenomenon — expect regression toward 0.15 floor by N=224. Do not draw paper claims from early N.

**No action**: Wait for cls B0 DOM cell completion (~12 hr remaining at current pace) before SR comparison vs archive.

### 236.2 Q2 — "Gallery 没标是 B0 还是 1 还是 2" — REAL BUG, FIXED

**Root cause**: `scripts/maintenance/generate_gallery.py:_build_groups()` used group key `(site, condition_id)`. For `phase1_paper_grade` multi-baseline aggregate gallery (`B0_3mode` + `B1_3mode` + `B2_3mode` prefix filter), the same `condition_id` (`phase1_dom_router_0`) exists in B0/B1/B2 run_dirs → `group_map` collapses three baselines into one row, losing baseline attribution in the UI.

**Fix** (4 surgical edits, `scripts/maintenance/generate_gallery.py`):

| line | change |
|---|---|
| 599 | Episode dict gains `baseline` field via `re.match(r"^(B[0-9]+)_", source_run_dir.name)` extraction |
| 329 | Group key `(site, condition)` → `(site, baseline, condition)` |
| 336 | `condition_label` decorated as `f"[{baseline}] {base_label}"` (e.g., `"[B0] Phase1 DOM mode"`) |
| 617 | Sort tiebreak adds `e.get("baseline", "")` so B0/B1/B2 cluster deterministically |

**Verified**: Regenerated `results/phase1_paper_grade/gallery.html` → `condition_label = "[B0] Phase1 DOM mode"` lands in JSON dump + h3 render. Watchdog 5th GALLERY step (`_regenerate_phase1_paper_grade_gallery` in `experiment_watchdog.py:1223`) will auto-pick the new logic on next post-step regen (within ~5-15 min of any Fire-3 task completion).

**Forward implication**: When B1 / B2 chains land later (B0 cls 6 modes → red chain 6 modes → B1 cls chain → ...), the phase1_paper_grade gallery will visually distinguish all 3 baselines × 6 modes per site = 36 cells × 2 sites without UI collision.

**Initial misjudgment (retracted within same audit)**: I first claimed "DOM mode by-design has no screenshot per CLAUDE.md 'dom: AXTree only, 无图'". **Wrong**: CLAUDE.md's "无图" describes the agent input modality (model receives no image input), NOT the trajectory artifact policy. - 91/91 step records across first 25 tasks have `artifact_paths.screenshot = null` (100% consistent)

**Diagnosed window**: 2026-05-15 (archive HAD screenshot) → 2026-05-18 (Fire-3 NO screenshot). Audit checked:
- `p79/envs/vwa_wrapper.py:_to_p79_obs()` image extraction `for k in ("image","screenshot","pixel","rgb")` — byte-identical archive↔HEAD
- `p79/experiment/runner/main.py:_save_artifacts()` — B-495 atomic-write wrap (2026-05-17) preserved `if getattr(obs, "image", None) is not None:` trigger
- VWA submodule pointer `832f037e → ac33d2fc` (5-15→5-18); processors.py diff = only `_barrier_meta` networkidle stamp + `_screenshot_primary_error` retry telemetry. `image_processor.process()` STILL always emits `(screenshot_ndarray, "")` for accessibility_tree mode

**Decision — Option A accepted (deferred fix)**: Do NOT hot-patch during Fire-3 cls B0 DOM cell.

**Justification**:
1. **Paper §3 evidence layer impact bounded**: Schema-v2 fields (`success`, `score`, `cost_usd`, `latency_ms`, `step_records.action`, `thought`) all canonical + present. 4. **annotate_screenshots.py post-processor is reversible**: If we later root-cause + fix, re-firing JUST cls B0 DOM (single cell, ~12 hr wallclock) regenerates `screenshot.png` files + the gallery `screenshot_annotated.png` overlays.

**Forward TODO**: `B-1760` filed → `next_steps.md` deferred bucket. Trigger: after cls B0 SoM cell lands (~5 days), deep-diagnose obs.image=None for accessibility_tree mode via runtime instrument. ### 238.3 Cross-AI ROI lesson — Multi-round /stress is paper-grade defense-in-depth

**Empirical retrospective**:

| Round | Mode A (self) catches | Mode B+C cross-AI catches | Push verdict |
|---|---|---|---|
| Round 1 (on substrate) | 7 findings (3 OOB) | +11 unique cross-AI = 18 unified total | (audit-only, no diff to push yet) |
| Round 2 (on Round-1 diff) | 5 small findings (0 push-blocker) | +9 unique cross-AI = **all 9 are push-blockers** Mode A missed | Push-blocker → fix required |

Round 1: Mode A's ratio = 7/18 = 38% of unified findings. Round 2: Mode A's ratio = 5/14 unique findings = 36% — but **0% of Mode A's findings were push-blockers**, while **100% of cross-AI's findings were push-blockers**. Mode A self-audit on its own fix-attempt fundamentally cannot escape the same lineage's framing/code blind spots. The "fix-attempt-failed" failure mode is **real** and **requires cross-AI to surface**.

**Most painful catches by lineage**:
- **codex F1** (R2-P0-1-B*) — caught the sequential-rule loophole that the cls→red sentinel fix only enforced in `case all`. Mode A saw the cls→red cascade fix and assumed "rule fully enforced" without re-auditing the case-statement structure. Cross-AI cold-read on the diff caught the path branch that didn't get hardened.
- **gemini F2** (R2-P0-3-C*) — caught the prose-vs-code mismatch on "decision rules unchanged" claim. Mode A wrote the prose AND wrote the code; couldn't see that `page_changed` semantic shift directly affects `no_progress` heuristic. Single-author paper review limitation — requires a reviewer who reads prose cold (gemini lineage strength).

**For paper-2 + future fix-waves**: **default multi-round /stress on fix-attempt diffs**. The cost (~7 min Mode B + 7 min Mode C = ~15 min wallclock) is dwarfed by the cost of pushing a fix-attempt-failed wave that contains 9 push-blockers.

## 242. SR run-to-run variance RCA (用户触发) — B0 MoE stochasticity 实测 + partial-run SR 双重不可比 + C1 eval-isolation 无 regression 确认 (2026-05-20) [finding][bug] #finding #bug

用户观察：历次 fire 的 cls SR 都 ~20% 但每次不同，怀疑是 B0 API 还是设置问题。matched-sample RCA (task 按顺序跑 → partial run 共享前缀，可取相同子集对比) 三层定性，并顺带给 Fire-6 的 C1 改动做了 before/after 审计。数据源 B0_dom_classifieds R19740(73)/R12090(101)/R14647(4)/R2987(Fire-6 in progress, 60)。

**Finding 1 — 真实 variance = B0 MoE stochasticity (T=0 仍翻转)**：matched 旧vs旧 (R19740∩R12090, 73 task) 有 **12% (9/73) task 对称翻转** (R19740-only=3 / R12090-only=6, net≈0)。铁证 = 步数：同一 task 三次 run 步数完全不同 (task 16=11/4/12, task 54=13/4/13, task 2=9/7/13)。`temperature: 0.0` + `seed: 42` 已确认 (configs 全 3 baseline)，仍翻转 → 根因 = B0 = Qwen3-VL-235B-**A22B MoE**，经 Bedrock batch serving 时 expert routing + GPU FP 累加顺序非确定性 → borderline token argmax 偶翻 → action 分叉 → 轨迹/outcome 翻转。**不可消除** (temperature 已 0)。

**Finding 2 — partial-run SR 双重不可比**：(a) 小 n binomial 噪声 (SE≈4.7pp @ n=73, ≈20pp @ n=4)；(b) **task-type composition bias (新洞察)** — R2987 前 60 task 的评测类型构成偏：`no_browser_required` (string_match, B0 弱项) 占 **43% (26/60) @ 7.7% SR**, `isolated_program_html_context` 15% (9) @ 0%, `agent_page` 42% (25) @ 20%, 加权 = 11.7%。VWA task 类型在 0-233 **非均匀分布**，按顺序跑时前缀构成系统偏离全集 → partial SR 不仅 n 小、连难度构成都偏。两大旧 run matched SR 实际很接近 (20.5% vs 24.7%, 差异在噪声内) → 用户"每次很不一样"大部分是 partial 错觉。

**Finding 3 — C1 (eval-isolation) 无 regression, 洗清**：R2987 `isolated_program_html_context` 路径 0/9 看似红旗，但 paired 对比定案：同 9 个 program_html task 旧 run 也仅 **1/9 success** (唯一 task 5, 且旧代码自己 flip: R19740 fail/R12090 succ) → C1 没把任何**稳定** success 变 fail；`eval_goto_latency_ms` 全部 **3.5–14s 健康无 30s timeout** → fresh `page.context.new_page()` 继承 login session、正常工作 (无重定向卡死);`agent_page` 路径 (C1 没碰, `eval_isolated_context_used=False`) SR=20% **与旧 run 一致** → agent 行为零退化。**C3a telemetry 反哺**: 为 Gate 8 加的 `eval_context_mode`/`eval_goto_latency_ms`/`eval_isolated_context_used` 字段直接拿来给自己的 C1 改动做审计 — 无这些字段则 "0/9" 会被误读为 C1 regression。

**Implication (paper)**: B0 cls noise floor ≈ 12% per-task flip。paper-grade gate = paired pooled FE superiority test (per-task 配对 + bootstrap)，对对称 flip 噪声 robust。但本次 empirically 确认 gemini /stress §A2 (2026-05-15) 已 flag 的 **self-consistency noise floor** 是真问题 — drop-one oracle 1.7–3.3pp 信号必须证明显著高于 stochastic floor。建议排 Fire-6 后：同一 condition 重跑 2× 量 SR 的 stochastic SD。

**Fire-6 决定**: 继续 (C1 三连证据无罪 + agent 行为零退化)。partial run SR 不可比 → 等跑完 234 全样本 SR 才首次可信。git 两边同步 (DGX=A100=`2953b60`, 无 unpushed, A100 无 auto-pull cron → DGX commit/push 不影响在跑的 fire; 唯一纪律 = fire 期间勿在 A100 手动 `git pull`/`checkout`, 因 sequential chain 每 cell 新进程重读磁盘代码)。

## 243. Fire-6 RCA 升级 → Protocol Reset 决策 (canonical Phase 1a = Upstream-Core VWA semantics + P79-GRL reliability layer) (2026-05-20) [finding][bug][design] #finding #bug #design

§242 SR variance RCA 继续深挖 → 双层 root cause + 用户 **Protocol Reset framing 决策**。**§242 "Fire-6 继续" 已反转**: Fire-6 task 64 transient proxy 503 fail-closed abort + R2987 matched 单向偏低暴露**系统性 parse_error** → Fire-6 停, Protocol Reset 前不重启。

**Root cause 1 (B0 serialization bug, 已修 A)**: `tool_choice="auto"` + system prompt `"Output ONLY valid JSON"` 双协议冲突 → B0 emit tool_calls 仅 22.5% → 77% 退 text-parse → 31% parse_error → 注入 wait 死循环 (吃 step budget)。probe 铁证: 126-char prompt (无 JSON 指令) emit 100% vs 真实 3881-char (含指令) emit **0%**; `tool_choice="required"` (OpenAI 字符串) emit 0%→100% / valid ~95% / logprobs 100% (对象格式 `{type:function}` proxy 静默吞, Anthropic `{type:tool}`/`{any}` HTTP 400)。B-991 (e7546f7, 05-18) 启用 tool_calling 漏改 prompt + retire GLM rescue (注释原文 "completely eliminating parse_error" → 之前 GLM 掩盖了 25-30% 真实 parse_error)。修复 A: `proxy_api_agent.py:611` auto→required + `exp_v2_base.yaml` 注释 (commit 待)。

**Root cause 2 (P79-vs-upstream 整体 prompt 偏离, 待 reset)**: agent 系统审查 + verify 坐实 **12+1 divergence** — P79 用自定义 prompt **完全替换** upstream CoT prompt (`agent/prompts/raw/p_cot_id_actree_3s.py`):
- **#1 zero-shot** (P79 0 examples vs upstream 5-shot "In summary") → absolute SR 不可与 literature 比 [validity-risk]
- **#4 wait action** (P79 发明 + parse-fail sink `action_utils.py:392`, upstream ActionTypes 无 WAIT) = 本次 RCA wait 死循环机制本身 [P79 design 非 bug]
- **#9 "NEVER give up / EXHAUSTIVE search"** (`_shared_vl_utils.py:86-87`, upstream 无) = 已知"无 N/A 出口 → N/A loop-to-truncation"根源 [validity-risk]
- **#5 dropped hover/press/new_tab/goto** (upstream ActionTypes 有, P79 `ALLOWED_ACTION_TYPES` 无) → task set 缩窄 [validity-risk]
- **#13 max_steps 半对齐**: 值 30=30 (B-700 对齐 upstream `run.py:105`) 但**语义偏离** — P79 `step_idx += 1` 无条件含 injected wait (bug 下 task 53 = 1 真决策 + 29 wait), upstream 30 = 30 agent decisions → 修复 D = **恢复 upstream agent-budget 语义, 非 P79 自创新语义**
- + JSON serialization / confidence field / tab 改名 (go_back→back) / scroll superset (left/right/delta) / select_option 提升 (upstream 有但不在 prompt) 等 [多数 disclose 级]

**Protocol Reset 决策 (用户 framing, §243 核心)**: canonical Phase 1a 重定义 = **"Upstream-Core VWA semantics + P79-GRL runtime/reliability layer"**。
- **原则**: benchmark 行为语义 (prompt/action/termination/max_steps) 尽量回 upstream; GRL 作为**明确贡献层**保留 (evaluator isolation / DOM screenshot timeout recovery / Gate 8 recurrent-failure registry / fail-closed quarantine / telemetry+provenance+SBOM / VWA evaluator bug fixes / wrapper reliability primitives / backend serialization adapters)。**GRL 边界 = make execution reliable, NOT change task policy**。
- **不再模糊叫 vanilla VWA**。新 framing prose: "We evaluate VWA tasks under upstream-aligned prompt/action/termination semantics, with a P79-GRL runtime layer for execution reliability and auditability."

**Reset Step 1-5 plan**:
1. **Protocol Reset Memo** (old protocol → problem → new protocol → policy)
2. **Prompt/action reset**: restore upstream few-shot (或显式声明 zero-shot controlled, 不比 literature absolute SR) / remove "NEVER give up / exhaustive" / WAIT 非 valid agent action / restore upstream action set 或 disclose filtering / **split serialization suffix** (B0 tool-call + required, B1/B2 text JSON, 共享 semantic action schema + 同一 validator)
3. **Accounting reset (two-budget)**: `max_agent_actions=30` (只 valid action 消耗) + safety (`max_model_attempts`~40-45 / `max_consecutive_parse_errors=3` / `max_total_parse_errors=5`) + injected wait `consumes_agent_action_budget=False`/`counts_as_runner_iteration=True` + 记录 `agent_action_step_count`/`valid_action_step_count`/`model_call_attempt_count`/`runner_iteration_count`/`parse_error_injected_wait_count` + **三列 cost** (`total_billed_cost_usd` 含 parse-error call / `canonical_action_cost_usd` 只 valid / `protocol_wasted_cost_usd` 单列) — **B0/B1/B2 同规则**
4. **Serialization health probes**: B0 tool+required ✓ / B1 JSON ✓ (0% parse_error, 149 steps) / **B2 待跑 (S4, B2 从未跑过)**
5. **only then restart canonical Fire** (8-item checklist: memo / upstream-core semantics 选定 / B0 tool suffix+required / B1B2 parse-health / max_steps agent-budget / cost split / B-991 污染数据标 non-canonical / GRL layer documented)

**数据有效性**: 所有 B-991(05-18) 后、B0 tool_choice fix 前的 B0 数据 = non-canonical (Fire-3/4/5/6 + R2987 = RCA/archive only)。若 prompt reset → **所有 pre-reset P79-custom-prompt 数据** (B0/B1/B2 全部) 只 pilot/archive, 不进新 canonical protocol。

**serialization health table (verify)**: B0 auto emit 0%/parse_error 25-30% · B0 required emit 100%/valid ~95% · B1 JSON parse_error **0%** (149 steps, 95% 上界<2%) · B2 未跑。S0-S5 audit: S0 ✓ (P79 自定义 serialization 非 upstream, upstream 用 markdown ```click [id]```) / S1-S2 ✓ / S3 ✓ (B1 0%) / S4 ✗ (B2) / S5 ✓ (B0/B1/B2 parse-fail accounting 共享 runner backend-agnostic)。

→ probe artifacts `/tmp/probe_toolchoice_v{2,4,5,6}.py` (DGX, 不入 git)。Final decision (用户): Stop Fire-6 → Protocol Reset → GRL 作为 explicit contribution 而非 hidden benchmark mutation → max_steps 修回 agent-action budget → serialization backend-split + schema 共享 → cost 三列 → 污染 B0 数据全 non-canonical。

## 244. Protocol Reset 总决策锁定 (12-point canonical) + S4 B2 parse-health closure (2026-05-20) [design][finding] #design #finding

用户 12-point final decision 锁定 Protocol Reset 为 canonical Phase 1a。§243 是 framing, **此 §244 是可执行 canonical 总决策**。所有后续实施以此 12 条为准。

**12-POINT CANONICAL DECISION**:
1. **Serialization closure**: B0 tool-call(required) / B1 text JSON / B2 text JSON = capability-forced backend split (B2 无 native tool-call ABI, chat template NO-TOOL-LOGIC)。三者**不需字节级输出一致**, 但**必须共享**: semantic action schema + validator + max_steps semantics + failure accounting + cost accounting。paper disclose backend-specific serialization。
2. **B-991(05-18) 后、tool_choice fix 前所有 B0 数据 non-canonical**: Fire-3/4/5/6 B0 candidate + R2987 = RCA/archive only, 不进 Phase 1a primary SR/cost/latency。
3. **Canonical protocol = Upstream-Core VWA semantics + P79-GRL runtime/reliability layer**。GRL = evaluator/runtime/provenance 层 (eval isolation C1/C1b, screenshot recovery, Gate8 quarantine, fail-closed, telemetry/SBOM, VWA eval bug fix, wrapper, backend serialization adapter), **NOT** prompt/action/task-policy 层。
4. **few-shot 不 restore** → disclose "zero-shot controlled protocol"; **不 claim absolute SR vs VWA literature**。Primary estimand = **within-protocol paired comparison across observation modes / routing** (phantom routing space, NOT SOTA SR)。
5. **action set divergence**: 先 targeted /stress (审 hover/press/new_tab/goto + goto domain restriction + shopping/WA dependency + schema/validator/wrapper/backend serialization/tests), **再 restore upstream-compatible action schema**。倾向 restore, stress 后实施。
6. **WAIT 非 canonical valid agent action**: runner-injected wait = internal recovery event only; `valid_agent_action=False` + `consumes_agent_action_budget=False`。
7. **max_steps 修回 upstream semantics = 30 valid agent-action opportunities**。two-budget: `max_agent_actions=30` (primary) + safety budget (`max_model_attempts` / `max_consecutive_parse_errors` / `max_total_parse_errors`)。
8. **parse_error 统一 B0/B1/B2 处理** (不要求绝对 0%): 不算 valid action step + 不消耗 max_agent_actions; **三列 cost** — raw `total_billed_cost` 记录 / `canonical_action_cost` 不计 parse-error call / `protocol_wasted_cost` 单列。
9. **C1/C1b/Gate8 per-error-class resolution 保持**, 严禁 task-level `resolved=true`。
10. **B-651 Holm family revert 回 (test, metric)**, 对齐 locked prereg + paper §3。
11. **B1/B2 speed investigation 独立 session**: 只允许 runtime optimization (vLLM/TGI/torch.compile/flash-attn), **禁改 prompt/action/schema/accounting semantics**。
12. **Fire-6 继续 HOLD** 直到 (protocol reset + action-set stress + accounting fixes + small smoke) 全部通过。

## 246. 加速 local 4B VL inference 研究 — vLLM Tier-0 spike: 4-5x model-only + action-parity 揭示 vLLM≠HF 行为分叉 (2026-05-20) [infra][finding] #infra #finding

独立 session (per §244 "vLLM 研究 → 独立 session #11")。问题: local 4B (B1 Qwen3-VL / B2 Gemma3) HF `model.generate` 慢 → Phase 1a fire B1+B2 ~100-120h 瓶颈。脚本 `scripts/spike/{spike_infer,spike_compare,spike_action_parity,run_action_parity,install_vllm}`，全在 A100 (`condense-a100`) 实测。

**根因诊断 (用户两假设均证伪)**: (a) max_new_tokens=4096 KV 开销 — 证伪 (HF DynamicCache 增量增长不预分配, 只有 StaticCache+compile 才预分配); (b) dom 模式仍 encode 图像 — 证伪 (`_clone_observation_for_mode` 对 dom 设 obs.image=None, 不走 vision tower)。**真因 = eager kernel-launch overhead**: 4B bf16 A100 实测 77ms/token (HF eager qwen 26.35 tok/s warmup 后), 内存带宽下限 ~5ms/token (~190 tok/s) → 差 >10x 全是 launch overhead (小模型+大卡+eager = launch-bound)。`generate_ms` 只测 generate(prefill+decode); short-output(~100tok)+medium-input(~2.3k) → prefill 占比放大 effective tok/s。

**Tier-0 spike (HF eager vs vLLM 单流, dom step, 真实 AXTree)**:
- **加速 (model-only)**: qwen 26.35→**112.38 tok/s (4.26x)**, gemma 20.76→**102.78 (4.95x)**。印证 launch-bound (vLLM CUDA graph PIECEWISE51+FULL35 + torch.compile 39s 一次性 + 优化 kernel)。
- **环境**: vllm **0.21.0** 装隔离 `.venv-vllm` (主 .venv tf 5.8.1/cu128 零污染; vLLM 自带 tf 5.9.0/cu130 共存 OK = Tier-1 第一绿灯)。**坑: flashinfer sampler JIT 需 nvcc, A100 无 CUDA toolkit** → `VLLM_USE_FLASHINFER_SAMPLER=0 VLLM_ATTENTION_BACKEND=FLASH_ATTN` 绕过 (Tier-1 部署配方关键; 或装 toolkit 用 flashinfer 可能更快)。
- **logprobs**: `SamplingParams(logprobs=2)` → 4/6 confidence (mean/min logprob + mean/min margin); entropy 需全词表 vLLM 不给 → None。**正好对齐 B0 的 4/6** (消除 B0-vs-B1/B2 不对称, router 不用 entropy 无影响)。revision SHA pin (`LLM(revision=...)`) 工作。

**Action parity (40 真实 dom step, 分层抽样长度谱 1096-4028 tok, HF dump input_ids → vLLM 复用同输入)** — Tier-1 go/no-go 关键数据:
- **qwen 90% / gemma 70%** (action_type+element_id 一致)。spot-check 确认**真分叉非 artifact**: 分叉在 thought 生成阶段 (greedy 下 kernel 数值微扰翻转 near-tie token → 级联改变推理分支 → 不同 action; 例 qwen "navigate back" vs "use search bar"; gemma thought 提前收尾 → scroll vs click)。
- **推翻 n=1 spike 的 "benign / migrate-all 低风险" 判断** (= 用户坚持扩样本的价值)。**vLLM≠HF 在行为层不可忽略, gemma 尤甚 (30% step 分叉)**。根因: 4B 决策脆弱 (near-tie 多), action 对 inference-engine 数值扰动敏感 (潜在 model-robustness side-finding)。
- **关键 reframe**: step-parity 是**最坏上界**, paper 真正关心 **episode-level SR delta** (多数分叉 step 不传导到 episode 成败) — **未验证**。

**Amdahl 约束**: generate 占 step ~55-65% (其余 env: page nav+AXTree+screenshot+`sleep_after_execution`)。单流 model 4-5x → 总 wallclock 顶 ~2x (100h→~50h, env 成新瓶颈)。突破 2x 需 concurrency (continuous batching 重叠 env 等待), 受 A2.11 (cls XOR red 同 host) 限制 — 是 VWA 侧限制非模型限制。

**决策状态 (未定)**: backend-canonical 待定。下一步 (用户定 2026-05-20): 冻结本结论入笔记 → 测 **torch.compile vs HF action 分叉率** (保 HF kernel 数值 → 分叉应远低于 vLLM; B1 优先, B2 受 transformers #42440 Gemma3 compile-incompat 阻需 inner-decoder workaround)。候选路线: vLLM-as-canonical 全量重跑 / torch.compile 保数值 / episode-SR-delta 验证 / HF 保守。

**Update (同 session, compile parity 实测 40 step, 同 vLLM 输入)**: torch.compile (default mode inductor fusion) vs HF eager action parity = **qwen 90% / gemma 72.5%** — **≈ vLLM (90%/70%), 无数值优势**。**推翻"compile 保 HF 数值"假设** (fusion 改 fp 累加顺序足以翻 near-tie; smoke n=3 3/3 = 本 session 第二次小样本误导, 第一次 = n=1 spike "benign")。compile 与 vLLM 分叉集**有交集** (qwen idx11/12 共同; gemma 7 个共同) = 共同 near-tie core + 引擎特异边缘 → 根因确认 = **模型决策脆弱性 (4B near-tie 多), 与引擎无关; 任何偏离 eager 的数值实现都翻 ~10%(qwen)/~28%(gemma) step action**。gemma compile 实际能跑 (tf 5.8.1 default mode 未触发 #42440) 但无优势。**决策收敛: torch.compile 出局 (无数值优势 + 4x<5x + 复杂); vLLM = 唯一值得加速路线; 既然换实现必改 step action, 最终 go/no-go = episode-SR-delta (step 分叉是否传导到 episode SR — step-parity 是最坏上界)**。方法论教训: 本 session 两次小样本 (n=1, n=3) 均给乐观假象被 n=40 推翻 → parity/divergence claim 必须 N≥30 (action-parity 版的 spotcheck 原则)。

**用户决策 (2026-05-20, 终局)**: **canonical run 禁 vLLM + 禁 torch.compile** (已证改 10-28% action)。§244 line 11 "允许 vLLM/torch.compile" vs "禁改 action semantics" 张力按 **解释 (b) reference-fidelity (数值结果层)** 裁定 → 排除所有改 action 输出的引擎 (唯一 action-identical = transformers eager 本身)。学长口头约束"用 transformers 不要 vllm" = 此立场, 现有实证支撑。加速只能走 **output-preserving** (每实例仍 eager, action bit-identical): (i) transformers eager 忍受慢; (ii) **多卡独占并行** (每卡一 site-chain, 无 GPU 争抢 → 各自 latency 干净; 但 A100 单卡 + Myriad 连不了 VWA → 当前无硬件); (iii) env 侧 *legitimate* 优化 (产出字节一致 obs 的真实加速, 不碰 model 数值且不改 page 时序 → 排除降 sleep_after_execution 因其改 obs→改 action)。**❌ 一卡多 eager 实例并发出局 (用户 2026-05-20 纠正)** — 虽 action bit-identical 但 **GPU 争抢污染 latency canonical** (笔记 line 306/380 04-07 "GPU 争抢延迟不可比"; latency 现已升 canonical estimand 2026-05-18 更严格)。**output-preserving 须 = action-preserving AND latency-preserving (双 canonical)**。⚠️ **跨 GPU 架构 (A100→H100) 可能也 flip near-tie action** (跨架构 fp 差异), 非无脑 output-preserving, 换卡需同架构或重验。Myriad 多 GPU ❌ (CGNAT 连不了 VWA); A100 单卡。vLLM spike 脚本+数据存档 `scripts/spike/` + A100 `/tmp/spike/` (隔离 `.venv-vllm` 可 `rm -rf` 撤)。

## 248. Protocol Reset accounting (§244 #6/#7/#8, task #70) — two-budget + 三列 cost 端到端落地 (2026-05-20) [infra][design][finding] #infra #design #finding

§244 12-point canonical 的 #6/#7/#8 实施完成 (catalog B-1784 two-budget + B-1785 三列 cost)。**不是 /stress 发现的 bug**, 是 §243 #13 "P79 `step_idx += 1` 无条件含 injected wait → upstream 30 agent-decision 语义偏离" 的修复 (deliberate restoration)。

**核心语义** (B0/B1/B2 同规则, runner backend-agnostic stamp):
- **#6 WAIT 非 canonical action**: `action_utils` 把所有 parse/structural 失败 rescue 成 `{"action_type":"wait"}` sink → internal recovery event, `valid_agent_action=False` + `consumes_agent_action_budget=False`, 不消耗 30-budget。
- **#7 two-budget**: loop `while step_idx < max_steps` → multi-budget (`agent_action_count < max_agent_actions=30` AND `step_idx < max_model_attempts` AND `consecutive_parse_errors < 3` AND `total_parse_errors < 5`)。`config.py`: `max_agent_actions` 继承 `max_steps` (零 yaml churn, per-condition yaml 已 30) + `max_model_attempts` 派生 (= budget + parse_cap + 10, scale-safe, 永不在 primary budget 耗尽前 cut)。
- **#8 三列 cost**: `total_billed` (所有 billed LLM call) / `canonical_action` (只 valid_agent_action steps = paper §1 估计量分子) / `protocol_wasted` (残差: parse-error + policy-blocked + recovery)。**加和闭合不变式 canonical + wasted ≡ billed** by construction (可测)。
- **B-1782 goto resolve**: off-site goto = `valid=False` (非合法 VWA 动作) + `consumes=True` (仍花 agent 一轮 turn) + `error_category="policy_blocked_offsite"` + `action_success=False`。是 valid≠consumes 的**唯一** divergence (防 agent 用 off-site goto 逃 budget; 与 parse-error 区分)。GRL catalog flag 的推荐 disposition 由此 resolve。

**工程决策 (paper-grade testability)**: classification + 3-cost 抽成 `metrics.py` 纯函数 (`classify_step_accounting` / `compute_three_column_cost`) → runner 调用 + 单测直打。`_avg_or_none` 保 Optional[float] "legacy vintage cannot compute" → None 一路传到 cross-site canonical-cost None-guard (镜像 `total_latency_canonical_ms` B-1780 pattern), 不被 `_avg` silent-0 掩盖。

**Schema**: StepRecordV2 +3 flag / EpisodeSummaryV2 +5 counter +3 cost, 全进 PAPER_GRADE_*_OPTIONAL_KEYS (KEY-presence) + _*_OPTIONAL_FIELD_TYPES (VALUE-type) + DEFAULTS。cold-start fixture (`_minimal_valid_*` 从 DEFAULTS 派生) 自动同步, 0 手改。

**Files**: `types.py` / `schema_migrations/v2.py` / `config.py` / `runner/main.py` (__init__ budget + two-budget loop + classification + step flags + episode rollup) / `metrics.py` (2 纯函数 + `_avg_or_none` + 8 condition-avg) / `aggregate_cross_site.py` (per-cell carry)。新测试 `tests/test_accounting_reset.py` (17: classification 4-case + 3-cost 加和闭合 + config budgets + MockEnv 集成断真实 output 不变式)。**全套 1192 passed / 10 skipped / 0 failed** (+21 vs 1171)。

## 249. Protocol Reset accounting — pre-fire /stress cross-AI audit (3-AI A+B+C) → B-1786 + §1 framing 调整 (2026-05-21) [infra][design][finding] #infra #design #finding

decision #12 gate: pre-fire /stress on §244 accounting (B-1784/1785) + action-set (#76)。**3-AI**: Claude Mode A (8) + codex Mode B (PASS 264s, Phase 4 3/3 real + 1 复现 TypeError) + gemini Mode C (PASS 46s<60s flagged 但 6741 tokens + Phase 4 2/2 反驳 failure premise → accept)。

**净结果（很干净）**: §244 核心机制 (two-budget = upstream agent-budget 对齐) **守住**；推翻**一个 framing 选择** + 修 **4 个我实现的真聚合 bug**（codex 抓的我盲区）。

**codex 抓我漏的 4 个真 bug**: (1) **异常路径** EpisodeSummaryV2 漏 5 counter + 3 cost → crash episode `steps>0 但 counters=0/cost=None` silent drift；(2) **published CSV/JSON drop 8 字段** → per-cell carry 只在 intermediate list，paper §1 估计量没进 artifact（我 #80 只做一半）；(3) `compute_three_column_cost` 遇 `model:None` **崩 TypeError**（复现）；(4) 新 cost 字段不在 `_HERO_NUMERIC_FIELDS` strict guard → "1e309"→inf poisoning 重开（复现）。

**gemini 独立挑战 §244 framing**: canonical-cost 作 §1 hero = "cherry-picker's estimand"（把 B0 parse-error 成本挪 protocol_wasted，美化 B0）；two-budget 给 buggy 模型 free-look（parse-error 不消耗 budget）。

**用户决策 (Q1=A / Q2=A / Q3=A)**: **不是承认 §244 错**，是把 paper §1 主估计量从 canonical-only 调成更难攻的 **`total_billed_cost` primary**（honest "what you pay"）+ canonical/wasted 降为 §4 efficiency 分解 + 暴露 `parse_error_rate`/`model_call_attempt`/parse-cap sensitivity 主动 defuse。**保 §244 代码不变**（two-budget 对齐 upstream 30-valid-action 是对的）；single-budget 回 advisor，不阻塞 Fire-6。goto 保 two-budget（parse-error 没形成 valid action 不消耗；off-site goto 是 valid-parsed 被 policy block 消耗）+ disclose。

**修复 (B-1786, P1+P2 全修, code-only)**: P1-1 异常路径 recompute；P1-2 published artifact 加 8 字段 + coverage + parse_error_rate（§1=total_billed）；P1-3 `_avg_or_none` + coverage_count/rate + `cost_coverage_partial` flag；P1-4 strict guard +8 字段；P1-5 `policy_blocked_offsite`→`fail_policy_blocked_offsite`→PAPER_TAXONOMY；P1-6 mixed-basis suppress 误导 plot；P2-1 model:None fallback；P2-4 fingerprint +budget 旋钮；P2-5 max_model_attempts clamp；P2-2 counts_as_runner_iteration 标 record-only。**P1-7 differential censoring + P0-1 estimand 挑战 = 非代码** → #74 disclosure + sensitivity sweep。`tests/test_accounting_reset.py` +5 回归 (22)。**全套 1197 passed / 0 failed**。

**方法论 win**: cross-AI 兑现价值——codex (code lineage) 抓我 4 个聚合盲区，gemini (design lineage) 抓 §244 framing 攻击，都是 Mode A 自审没到的深度/角度。**总体 framing 收口**: §1 = SR + total_billed_cost + latency；§4 = canonical + protocol_wasted + valid_action_steps + parse_error_rate + sensitivity。

**剩余 → Fire-6**: #74 docs (Memo + §3.5 disclose 含 total_billed-primary framing + GRL contribution) → small smoke → Fire-6 (HOLD 直到全过)。

## 251. B-1794 真根因 = `tool_choice="required"` forcing（非 schema-prompt 不一致）+ 真修复 schema≡validator + 跨 baseline 一致性 (2026-05-21) [bug][finding][design] #bug #finding #design

**§250.3 的"schema-prompt 不一致"根因 + §250.4 的 description 修(`8668a84`)是早期假设，实证证伪。** 用户连续 3 指令推进调查：「更多实验只要不调 API」→「用 myriad/condenser」→「可用 API」，最终真 proxy 锁定。investigation 脚本在 `scripts/spike/`（audit_b0_grounding / payload_diff_b0_b1 / local_toolcall_eid_experiment / probe_b0_proxy_variants / probe_b0_fix_confirm / probe_b0_comprehensive_schema）。

### 251.1 description 修无效 + 排除法
- **`8668a84`(description-only) re-run：3/3 仍 `invalid_element_id`** —— B0 emit type 缺 element_id + 捏造 url。改的是 prose 层；tool-calling 模式模型跟结构 schema，不跟 prose。
- **本地 Qwen3-VL-4B（A100，非 API）**：同 B0 optional schema，4B **照发 element_id=140** → **证伪「schema-optional 是根因」**；并排除 capability/grounding（4B 完美 ground 匿名 textbox）。
- **2026-05-17 proxy probe（已有）**：235B 在 **click** 发 element_id（`[2]` 已 coerce）→ 235B 能发，独 type/search 漏。

### 251.2 真根因（真 proxy variant probe，决定性）
6 变体真 proxy：`tc=required` baseline 漏 eid+url ❌ · **`tc=auto` 发 eid=140 ✓** · `eid 进 required` 发 ✓ · 删 url 仍漏(换 option_label 凑数) · prompt nudge 仍漏。
**真根因 = `tool_choice="required"` 强制本身**：Bedrock 被迫发 tool call → 产出只满足 required 数组(action_type+thought)的 **minimal/degenerate call** → 漏所有 optional 字段（element_id 因 235B 有「搜索=输入查询+跳 URL」竞争 prior 最易漏）。`tc=auto` 不强制 → 模型自然发完整 call 带 eid。完美解释 B-991 史（auto→0% tool call→改 required→required 修了 0% 但引入 degenerate 漏 eid）。

### 251.3 真修复 + 用户的一致性洞察（关键）
- **修（B-1794, `681b9cf`）**：per-action 条件 required（allOf if/then）放进 `_WEB_ACTION_TOOL`。proxy variant probe 6/6 + comprehensive probe 5/5 + 多 search/listing 页全 valid。
- **用户洞察**：「所有 optional 语义必需字段都有 forcing 漏洞，是不是确保 B0 与 B1/B2 一致的关键？」→ **是**。机制：三 baseline 共享 `validate_action_detailed`（B1/B2 经 `parse_action_text`、B0 经 tool_call）；**schema required 必须 ≡ validator（不严不松）**。我一度给 type 多加 `text`-required，被用户一致性框架抓出（validator `type(eid,no-text)=valid` 不要求 text）→ 移除。schema≡validator 程序化证明 8/8 + **10 invariant 测试**（`tests/test_b0_schema_validator_consistency.py`）。`anyOf(eid|coord)` 兼容 vision。
- **验证**：2×30 步 dom smoke **0 invalid**（type/scroll×23/click/select_option/back）；1207 pytest。

### 251.4 provenance + serialization-adapter framing（用户问「tool-calling/JSON 是上游的吗」）
- **上游 VWA = 文本串** `click [id]` / `type [id] [content]`（regex 解析，`external/visualwebarena/agent/prompts/prompt_constructor.py::_extract_action`），**既非 JSON 也非 tool-call**（grep `tool_choice|tools=` = 0）。
- P79 = structured serialization adapter（B0 tool-call / B1/B2 JSON），**P79 自创非继承**。**决策（§19 + edff6e1）**：维持 backend-specific serialization，不统一（JSON=B-991 0%-tool-call 失败 / 上游文本串=全 agent I/O 重写，pre-Fire-6 风险大收益小）。
- **reframe**：「upstream-core VWA semantics」→「**upstream-aligned task/action/evaluator/termination semantics + P79 structured serialization adapters + P79-GRL reliability layer**」。**不主张 byte-level 格式等价**。
- 落地：§3.5.1 披露 + §19 decision（`edff6e1`）；pre-fix B0 archive non-canonical（Amendment 01）；locked 文件（prereg/Amendment-01）"upstream-core" reframing → 未来 amendment，不 retro-edit（witness/DOI 锁）。

B0 element_id blocker CLOSED → **Smoke A 三 baseline 全过**（B0 修前 step0 即死，修后跑满 30 步）。decision #12 闸：protocol reset ✓ + action-set stress ✓ + accounting ✓ + smoke ✓（全 3）。**paper 级含义**：所有 pre-fix B0 archive（Fire-3/4/5）被此 artifact 系统性压低 search/type SR → B0 历史上是「残废 baseline」、对比不公；Fire-6 是 B0 首次公平测量。剩：§3.5 GRL doc(#74)、artifact-aggregation 检查、Fire-6 launch 前 /stress。

## 253. Fire-6 cls 在 task 4 abort（第 4 次）→ 真根因 = 退化 BrowserContext（非 agent-modified substrate）→ B-1803 fresh-context eval isolation → re-fire (2026-05-21) [bug][finding][infra] #bug #finding #infra
